## ❓ 常见问题 / FAQ

- macOS 提示「已损坏」或「无法验证开发者」：在「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性」中点击「仍要打开」/ macOS says the app can't be verified: choose *Open Anyway* in *System Settings → Privacy & Security*
- 使用说明：[README](https://github.com/Souitou-iop/MyGO-Clash#readme)
- 反馈问题 / Report a problem：[Issues](https://github.com/Souitou-iop/MyGO-Clash/issues)
- 更新日志 / Changelog：[CHANGELOG](https://github.com/Souitou-iop/MyGO-Clash/blob/{tag}/CHANGELOG.md)
